title: Abuzzinian buffed, Member Club retuned, new summon pack art
summary: Abuzzinian's Gathering Storm is buffed sharply at levels 11 and 21 alongside its thunder damage buffs, the Member Club trial is shortened but pays more, a fourth city UR monster refresh tier and three new training task groups appear, mounts are re-sorted, and 38 new season-one summon and city race textures are registered.
highlights: Abuzzinian: Gathering Storm level 11 buff 150% → 480% and level 21 buff 300% → 800%; ThunderHurtAdd 15,000 → 48,000 and ThunderHurtAdd1 5,000 → 6,000 (secondary value 30,000 → 80,000).
Member Club (Android): duration 30 → 7 days, reward 10,000 → 20,000, times set to 3.
City UR monster refresh gains a fourth tier of Palmon spawn weights.
Training tasks gain groups 14-16 (days 1-14, 15-28, 29-42) with new gift rewards.
Mount sort order changes for Swiftger, Amourphibian and Slackycapy; the 2027 Birthday Card gets a new icon.
38 new season-one summon pack, use-item and city race hero textures plus two task pictures registered.
